name: Float
body:
Discipline psychoportation; Level cryptic 1, gifted blade 1, marksman 0, psion/wilder 0, psychic warrior 0

MANIFESTING

Display: auditory
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 rnd./lvl. (D)
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You mentally support yourself in water or similar liquid. You can swim at a speed of 5 feet using the power alone, or, if you already have a swim speed, this power boosts your swim speed by 5 feet.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, your swim speed and bonus to swim speed increases by +5 feet.

Editor’s Note

This power was listed on the Cryptic power list in Psionics Expanded, but this information was omitted from the power description. Errata on the Dreamscarred Press forums confirmed that it is available to the Cryptic as per the published power list. This power’s entry has been updated to reflect this.
